properties.entry: SELECT C.CATEGORY_NAME, SUM(T.TRANS_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM PERSONAL_TRANSACTIONS T JOIN PERSONAL_CATEGORIES C ON T.CATEGORY_NUM = C.CATEGORY_NUM WHERE T.USER_NUM = ? AND T.TRANS_TYPE = ? AND DATE_FORMAT(T.TRANS_DATE, '%Y-%m') = ? AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY C.CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_AMOUNT DESC

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRANS_TYPE = 'I' THEN TRANS_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TOTAL_INCOME, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRANS_TYPE = 'E' THEN TRANS_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TOTAL_EXPENSE FROM PERSONAL_TRANSACTIONS WHERE USER_NUM = ? AND DATE_FORMAT(TRANS_DATE, '%Y-%m') = ? AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(TRANS_DATE, '%Y-%m') AS TRANS_MONTH, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRANS_TYPE = 'I' THEN TRANS_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TOTAL_INCOME, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRANS_TYPE = 'E' THEN TRANS_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TOTAL_EXPENSE FROM PERSONAL_TRANSACTIONS WHERE USER_NUM = ? AND TRANS_DATE >= DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(?, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 5 MONTH) AND TRANS_DATE < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(?, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(TRANS_DATE, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY TRANS_MONTH ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(TRANS_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS TRANS_DATE, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRANS_TYPE = 'I' THEN TRANS_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DAILY_INCOME, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRANS_TYPE = 'E' THEN TRANS_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DAILY_EXPENSE FROM PERSONAL_TRANSACTIONS WHERE USER_NUM = ? AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT T.TRANS_NUM, T.TRANS_TYPE, T.CATEGORY_NUM, C.CATEGORY_NAME, T.TRANS_AMOUNT, DATE_FORMAT(T.TRANS_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS TRANS_DATE, T.TRANS_MEMO FROM PERSONAL_TRANSACTIONS T JOIN PERSONAL_CATEGORIES C ON T.CATEGORY_NUM = C.CATEGORY_NUM WHERE T.USER_NUM = ? AND T.USE_YN = 'Y'
INSERT INTO PERSONAL_TRANSACTIONS (USER_NUM, CATEGORY_NUM, TRANS_TYPE, TRANS_AMOUNT, TRANS_DATE, TRANS_MEMO) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, STR_TO_DATE(?, '%Y-%m-%d'), ?)
UPDATE PERSONAL_TRANSACTIONS SET CATEGORY_NUM = ?, TRANS_TYPE = ?, TRANS_AMOUNT = ?, TRANS_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(?, '%Y-%m-%d'), TRANS_MEMO = ? WHERE TRANS_NUM = ? AND USER_NUM = ?
UPDATE PERSONAL_TRANSACTIONS SET USE_YN = 'N' WHERE TRANS_NUM = ? AND USER_NUM = ?
